attchmntText: Bharat Dynamics Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bharat Dynamics Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board approved the results on 12 November 2026. Revenue from operations was 1,66,413.58 lakhs for the quarter ended 30.09.26 and 2,23,637.61 lakhs for the half year ended 30.09.26. Profit for the period was 18,348.31 lakhs for the quarter and 30,227.42 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 5.01 for the quarter and 8.25 for the half year. A final dividend of Rs. 0.40 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26 was approved by shareholders on 28 September 2026. The statutory auditors conducted a limited review of the financial results.
